---
title: Themes
description: Restyle the sign-in and account pages for a tenant or a client with a stylesheet.
---

A theme is a CSS file that changes how the sign-in, consent, and account pages look. masks loads it
after its own stylesheet.

- In development, masks reads themes on every request.
- Everywhere else, masks reads them once and keeps them until the server restarts. A new or changed
  file applies after a restart.

## A logo and a color

You can set a logo and a color without a stylesheet. A manager who holds `masks:manage` sets both
in `/manage`, under **Settings**, then **General**, then **Branding**.

- The logo replaces the tenant's initial at the top of the sign-in, consent, and account pages. It
  can be an image up to 4 megabytes. masks stores it at 256 pixels square.
- The **Accent color** tints the buttons and headings on those pages. It sets `--signal` and
  `--brass`, and sets `--signal-ink` to black or white, whichever reads better on it.

A theme loads after both, and can override them.

## Naming a theme

masks reads themes from the directory that `MASKS_THEMES_PATH` names. Without it, masks reads the
app's `themes` directory, which is `/rails/themes` in the container image. A file's name sets where
it applies.

| File                   | Applies to                                                                        |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `acme.css`             | Every sign-in and account page of the tenant `acme`.                              |
| `acme/<client_id>.css` | The sign-in and consent pages of `acme` while the person signs in to that client. |

- A page loads the tenant's file first and the client's file second. The client's rules win when
  the two files disagree.
- The account page names no client, so it loads only the tenant's file.
- masks skips a file larger than 256 kilobytes, and the server logs a warning.

## Adding a theme

1. Write the stylesheet. Set the custom properties below on `.auth-page`. Set them once for light
   mode, and once inside `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` for dark mode:

   ```css
   .auth-page {
     --ground: #f4f7fb;
     --surface: #eaf0f7;
     --line: #d3dce7;
     --ink: #14202e;
     --signal: #1f5fbf;
     --signal-ink: #ffffff;
   }

   @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
     .auth-page {
       --ground: #151c26;
       --surface: #1d2632;
       --line: #2e3a49;
       --ink: #e6edf5;
       --signal: #7fb0ff;
       --signal-ink: #0d1520;
     }
   }
   ```

   A property you leave unset keeps masks' default.

2. Mount the directory into the container:

   ```yaml
   services:
     masks:
       volumes:
         - masks-storage:/rails/storage
         - ./themes:/rails/themes:ro
   ```

3. Restart the server.

masks serves the file from `/themes/<digest>.css`. The digest is a value computed from the file's
contents, so it changes whenever the file changes. Browsers cache each version for a year.

## Custom properties

A custom property is a CSS variable, a name that starts with `--`. Each one sets a color or a size
that masks uses across the pages.

| Property                       |                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--ground`                     | The page background.                                                                                             |
| `--surface`                    | Panels, cards, and fields that sit on the ground.                                                                |
| `--line`                       | Borders and dividers.                                                                                            |
| `--line-firm`                  | Borders of fields and of hovered or focused controls.                                                            |
| `--ink`                        | Body text.                                                                                                       |
| `--ink-soft`                   | Secondary text, hints, and labels.                                                                               |
| `--brass`                      | Structural rules, the edge of the tenant's mark, eyebrows, status labels, and the name beside an avatar.         |
| `--brass-lit`                  | Focus rings and the border of a focused field.                                                                   |
| `--signal`                     | The primary button, links, and selected controls.                                                                |
| `--signal-ink`                 | Text on a solid `--signal` fill.                                                                                 |
| `--bad`, `--bad-field`         | Error text and the background behind it.                                                                         |
| `--warn`, `--warn-field`       | Warning text and the background behind it.                                                                       |
| `--info`, `--info-field`       | Informational text and the background behind it.                                                                 |
| `--glow`                       | The background of pills and plain notes.                                                                         |
| `--window`                     | A blurred image behind the top right of the page. `url("/masks-public/icon.svg")` by default. `none` removes it. |
| `--window-strength`            | The opacity of that image, from `0` to `1`.                                                                      |
| `--pane`                       | The see-through fill of panels. Panels blur what is behind them.                                                 |
| `--pane-rim`                   | The border of panels.                                                                                            |
| `--pane-shine`, `--pane-sheen` | The highlight along a panel's top edge, and the gradient across its face.                                        |
| `--pane-shadow`                | The shadow under panels.                                                                                         |
| `--bend`                       | The corner radius of panels and controls.                                                                        |

A theme may also style any other selector on these pages. The properties above stay the same
between releases. Class names can change.

## What a theme can load

A theme does not change the pages' content security policy. This policy tells the browser where a
page may load files from. Images and fonts load only from masks itself or from `data:` URIs. A
`data:` URI holds the file's contents inside the stylesheet.

A theme must do one of these:

- Embed each image or font as a `data:` URI.
- Name a font installed on the device.

The browser refuses an `@import` or `url()` that points at another host.
